game.rules: Standard Tetris. The board is 10 columns wide and 20 rows tall. You control the falling piece one move at a time, like a player at the keyboard. Gravity pulls the piece down one row at a time while you decide, and it locks shortly after it rests on the stack. A full row disappears. The game is lost when the stack reaches the top. This is a versus match: cleared lines attack the opponent.
game.legend: # is the stack, @ is the falling piece you control, . is empty. The first row is the top of the board.

instructions.question: Which move should the player make now with the falling piece (@) in `game.board_rows_top_to_bottom`? The options are the controls that work right now.
objective: Survive as long as possible and clear as many lines as possible.
In versus mode every line you clear is pushed onto the opponent's board as a garbage row, and the first player whose stack reaches the top loses.
The piece keeps falling while you think, so a move that is not made soon may stop being possible.

criteria.left: Move the piece one column to the left.
criteria.right: Move the piece one column to the right.
criteria.drop: Send the piece straight to the bottom right now and lock it there. Gravity is the only other way down.
